editorial:
The Wasp Woman is a 1959 American film directed by Roger Corman. Production companies are listed as The Filmgroup and Santa Cruz Productions, and it was distributed by Allied Artists. Susan Cabot plays Janice Starlin, with Anthony Eisley as Bill Lane and Barboura Morris as Mary Dennison. Leo Gordon wrote the screenplay from a story by Kinta Zertuche, and Fred Katz composed the music.

The rights question is the film's renewal. A 1959 release would have needed a renewal filed in its 28th year, around 1987. Printed Catalog of Copyright Entries volumes ended in 1977, so a 1986-1988 renewal would appear only in the Copyright Office online records (publicrecords.copyright.gov). Those records were not searched in this session, so this dossier cannot confirm a renewal either way. Wikipedia links to its list of US public-domain films from the article, but that is not a primary record. Search the Copyright Office catalog for the title before relying on the print. The score and story layers are not independently cleared.
